_comment: Processor register (C-34). Feeds the export (C-7) and the DPIA. Facts marked [verify] are unconfirmed. dpa_status: unknown | needed | signed. Not legal advice. No processor receives user data until reviewed (P-11).

processors.name: OpenRouter
processors.purpose: Routes all AI requests (mentor, rule expansion, photo reaction, ingestion, Q&A) to model providers
data_categories: health (only with ai_health consent: rules, symptoms, meal text, journey phase)
processors.retention: Required: zero data retention. Pinned in code (apps/api/src/ai/openrouter.ts, C-14): every request sends provider.zdr: true and provider.only/order = AI_PROVIDERS (the allow-list); prompt logging off at account level. Actual terms [verify]
processors.training_use: Must be denied. Pinned in code (apps/api/src/ai/openrouter.ts, C-14): every request sends provider.data_collection: "deny"; never a :free model (config refuses one). Actual terms [verify]
processors.deletion_api: unknown [verify]; target is none needed because nothing is retained
processors.sub_processors: Upstream model providers behind AI_MODEL (qwen/qwen3.8-27b); set varies with routing [verify]
processors.notes: Hardest review (C-34). Never use :free variants for health-adjacent calls.

processors.name: Model providers behind OpenRouter (allow-list, to be chosen)
processors.country: unknown; some Qwen hosts may be outside the US/EU [verify]
processors.notes: Covered only through OpenRouter's terms; pin an allow-list (C-14) and re-review quarterly.

processors.name: Hetzner (compute, Postgres host, Object Storage, backups, voice GPU)
processors.purpose: Hosting for API, database, photo storage, voice service, backups
data_categories: all stored data: identifier, usage, technical in the clear; health as ciphertext
processors.retention: Our own policies apply (C-6, C-35); provider wipes decommissioned media [verify]
processors.deletion_api: S3-compatible object delete for photos; database deletion is ours
processors.transfer_mechanism: EU hosting; no transfer for EU users [verify]
processors.notes: Hetzner offers a GDPR Art. 28 DPA [verify current]. No HIPAA BAA expected [verify]. Not needed under option (a).

processors.name: Mail provider (TBD)
processors.purpose: Send magic-link sign-in emails and service notices
processors.retention: TBD; target logs of 30 days or less, open and click tracking off
processors.deletion_api: TBD; need suppression-list and recipient deletion (C-8)
processors.status: planned M2 (SMTP mailer exists; provider not chosen) / M12
processors.notes: Spec says 'existing mailing infrastructure'; identify it and confirm it is a processor, not a joint controller [verify]. See requirement N-1 in risk-register.md; required provider settings are in mail-provider.md.

processors.name: GlitchTip
processors.purpose: Error reporting (scrubbed stack traces, route, request id)
data_categories: no request data, breadcrumbs or email (before_send, C-9)
processors.country: self-hosted on Hetzner (EU) [verify; spec says 'the existing GlitchTip']
processors.deletion_api: project/event deletion in the GlitchTip admin if self-hosted
processors.notes: If self-hosted by Multiverse Games it is not a separate processor, but the host is Hetzner. If a hosted SaaS, a DPA is needed. Confirm who else shares that instance (other Multiverse games) and who can read it.

processors.name: PixelLab
processors.purpose: Pixel-art generation for game assets (build time)
data_categories: none (no user data; prompts and art only)
processors.training_use: n/a for user data; check licence terms for generated art [verify]
processors.notes: Must never receive user data. A DPA is not required while that holds; keep it out of any runtime path.

processors.name: Web Push services (Google FCM, Apple, Mozilla)
data_categories: generic text only, encrypted per RFC 8291 (C-24)
processors.notes: Added beyond the requested list; named in the compliance report §1.5. No health content in any payload.

processors.name: Merchant of Record / payment provider (TBD)
data_categories: billing identity and card data (held only by the provider)
processors.notes: Added beyond the requested list; named in the compliance report §1.5. Kitchen Quest never stores card data. No health data is shared.
